titles.mode: How do you want to remix?

stitch.title: Stitch
stitch.text: Record a clip that plays before or after the original.

reaction.title: Reaction
reaction.text: Record yourself while the original plays.

free.title: Free edit
free.text: Open the editor with the original on the timeline.

stitchBefore.title: Before the original
stitchBefore.text: Your clip plays first, then the original.

stitchAfter.title: After the original
stitchAfter.text: The original plays first, then your clip.

overlay.title: Overlay
overlay.text: Your camera in a small box on top of the original. Drag it anywhere.

tileTop.title: Tile above
tileTop.text: Original shrinks to the bottom half, you on top.

tileBottom.title: Tile below
tileBottom.text: Original shrinks to the top half, you below.
